inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved parent class value.

profiles.name: Kinetic Chirurgeon

constraints.summary: Aether or water must be selected as the primary element.

evidence.reason: Kinetic healer, mercies, stronger healing and emergency revival replace offensive infusions and metakinesis.

profiles.playerSummary: A Kineticist who gives up infusions and much of the blast toolkit to become a burn-powered healer, mercy user and emergency reviver.
profiles.tradeoff: Its offensive blast remains, but area shaping and infusion versatility are sharply reduced.

profiles.name: Kinetic Knight

constraints.summary: Several defences require heavy armour and an attuned shield.

evidence.reason: The blast is restricted to kinetic blade and its descendant infusions, making close combat defining.

profiles.playerSummary: An armoured elemental knight who turns kinetic blast into blades and whips, fights with a shield and uses resolve to stay standing.
profiles.tradeoff: Ordinary ranged blasting and stealth are surrendered for equipment-heavy melee durability.

profiles.name: Eldritch Archer

constraints.summary: The arcane bond must be a ranged weapon.

evidence.reason: Both signature Magus delivery features are rebuilt around ranged weapons.

profiles.playerSummary: A Magus who channels spell combat and spellstrike through a bonded ranged weapon.
profiles.tradeoff: Its signature action loop is tied to ranged attacks and loses the normal melee emphasis.

profiles.name: Bladebound

constraints.summary: A sentient black blade has its own mission, Ego and potential conflicts with its wielder.

evidence.reason: A permanent sentient weapon replaces part of the Magus arcana and arcane-pool progression.

profiles.playerSummary: A Magus permanently partnered with a growing sentient black blade that has powers, resources, opinions and a mission of its own.
profiles.tradeoff: The weapon type is fixed, familiars are forbidden and the blade can resist its wielder through Ego conflicts.

profiles.name: Spirit Dancer

evidence.reason: The current spirit’s seance boon is projected to every nearby ally.

profiles.playerSummary: A Medium who prepares all six legends and changes between their powers through a limited spirit dance.
profiles.tradeoff: Exceptional flexibility is compressed into limited rounds and carries influence, lockout and post-dance penalties.

profiles.name: Reanimated Medium

constraints.summary: At zero influence the body enters a helpless, deathlike coma for 24 hours.

evidence.reason: The spirit can linger after death and gains strong defence, eventually immunity, against death and negative energy.

profiles.playerSummary: A dead spirit inhabiting its own restored body, growing stronger through reversed influence and resisting death, possession and negative energy.
profiles.tradeoff: Influence works backwards, and exhausting it leaves the body helpless for an entire day.

profiles.name: Vexing Daredevil

evidence.reason: Weapon attacks, feints, free movement, manoeuvres and follow-up strikes become the archetype’s central loop.

profiles.playerSummary: A martial Mesmerist who feints stared targets to blind, reposition, manoeuvre or strike again.
profiles.tradeoff: Touch treatment and several tricks are exchanged for a weapon-and-feint routine.

profiles.name: Cult Master

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The source explicitly builds a cult leader who recruits, manipulates and commands a cohort and followers.

evidence.reason: The archetype buffs followers, gains Leadership and implants tricks specifically in its organisation.

profiles.playerSummary: A charismatic cult leader who recruits followers, strengthens their fanaticism and uses them as agents, shields and eventual vessels.
profiles.tradeoff: Many benefits require a cohort or followers and introduce substantial additional-character management.

profiles.name: Zen Archer

evidence.section: Flurry of Blows / Way of the Bow
evidence.reason: Flurry, scaling damage, Wisdom accuracy and ki techniques are all rebuilt around bows.

profiles.playerSummary: A disciplined bow specialist who flurries at range, shoots through cover and applies ki techniques through arrows.
profiles.tradeoff: Most signature combat features require a bow, substantially increasing equipment dependence.

profiles.name: Tetori

evidence.reason: The entire progression specialises in initiating, maintaining and preventing escape from grapples.

profiles.playerSummary: A relentlessly specialised grappling Monk who suppresses magical escapes, anchors shapeshifters and can seize incorporeal foes.
profiles.tradeoff: Flurry, mobility and several broad defensive features are traded for an exceptionally narrow control style.
